thread: "My coins are safe, my key is secret." Mostly true — until you spend. The moment you transact, your public key is exposed on-chain. 🧵 Why that matters for a quantum future. #QuantumComputing #Bitcoin 1/
A future quantum attacker doesn't need your private key — they could derive it from an exposed public key. Reused/exposed-key addresses are the soft targets. 2/

The fix isn't panic, it's migration: post-quantum signatures (e.g. NIST's CRYSTALS-Dilithium). That's the foundation of QVAULT's phase-3 L1. Start preparing before you have to. ⬡ $QVLT #PostQuantum #Solana 3/3
